scope.platformBoundary: HOY is a multi-vertical local intent and commerce platform; Gastro is the first measurable proof vertical, not the product boundary.

objective: Use current local competitors as market-validation evidence while building a measurable HOY advantage in freshness, decision quality, trusted structured data, actionability, merchant value and repeatable regional/cross-vertical execution.

evidence.fact: The site actively publishes La Manga and Cabo de Palos local guides across restaurants, family plans, activities, beaches and destination topics; a kitesurf guide was published on 2026-08-17.
Cadena SER reported on 2026-07-23 that Viviendo La Manga creator Marioly Vivancos participated in a La Manga local radio event and shared recommendations about plans and lesser-known places.

marketEvidence.name: TuLocalidad / El Paladar de la Huerta

evidence.fact: TuLocalidad presents itself as a digital showcase connecting local businesses with nearby residents.

El Paladar de la Huerta publishes search-oriented Murcia restaurant guides and sends readers to TuLocalidad for geo-located restaurant menus and current prices; the page self-reports analysis of 312 menus.

marketValidationConclusion.conclusion: Active local destination discovery, restaurant editorial content, local-business directory mechanics and menu discovery are observable in the target market/category. This reduces category-existence risk but does not prove HOY demand, HOY product-market fit or HOY superiority.

positioning.hoyQuestion: What fits me now, why can I trust it, and what can I do next?
positioning.antiCloneRule: HOY must not win by becoming a larger generic directory. Directory coverage is table stakes; the differentiated product is current decision support plus trusted actionability.

attackTracks.name: Coverage and discoverability parity
attackTracks.purpose: Remove avoidable discovery disadvantages without optimizing for vanity traffic.
requiredWork: Measure Region-1 business/category/area coverage against an explicit baseline.
Create canonical indexable area/category/use-case surfaces only where they answer real user intent.
Use structured metadata and canonical URLs; prohibit doorway-page or thin-page SEO tactics.
Track search discovery only together with downstream qualified engagement/high-intent behavior.

attackTracks.name: Freshness and HOY NOW superiority
attackTracks.purpose: Make current decision state materially more useful than static listings.
requiredWork: Keep unknown, stale and unverified state fail-closed rather than guessing.
Expose current opening/service/offer/event/live-status facts only under their verification rules.
Measure freshness SLA and stale-critical-field rate.

attackTracks.name: Menu decision advantage
attackTracks.purpose: Turn menus into a uniform decision layer rather than images, links or mixed-language source dumps.
requiredWork: Complete HOY-native structured menus in DE, ES and EN under the strict current-language guest contract.
Preserve source truth, integrity and rights boundaries.
Use structured dishes for price, dietary and decision use cases only when data quality permits.

attackTracks.name: Decision UX instead of directory UX
attackTracks.purpose: Help a user choose now rather than browse an undifferentiated list.
requiredWork: Prioritize contextual choice inputs such as open now, time, distance, budget, dietary needs, family context and accessibility requirements when evidence exists.
Keep MUST/PREFER/IGNORE accessibility semantics and unknown-as-confirmation-required behavior.
No universal opaque ranking score that hides missing evidence.

attackTracks.name: Trust and first-party confirmation
attackTracks.purpose: Make the reason to trust a fact explicit and auditable.
requiredWork: Expand factual operator confirmation only through verified merchant paths.
Keep factual confirmation separate from commercial rights clearance.
Expose verification/freshness semantics to product and buyer evidence without overstating certainty.

attackTracks.name: Actionability and merchant outcome
attackTracks.purpose: Convert discovery into attributable high-intent actions while preserving outcome truth.
requiredWork: Maintain route, website, call, reservation and service handoff events under the ACQ-04 semantics.
Never label a handoff as a confirmed transaction without independent confirmation.
Measure merchant-acknowledged and merchant-confirmed outcomes separately from intent.

attackTracks.name: Editorial authority without generic SEO content
attackTracks.purpose: Compete with strong local editorial discovery using evidence-rich regional usefulness rather than generic AI-looking volume.
requiredWork: Publish only region-specific guides with a clear user decision job and source/evidence policy.
Connect editorial surfaces to live HOY structured data instead of maintaining disconnected duplicate facts.
Measure assisted high-intent behavior, not article count.

attackTracks.name: Cross-vertical local intent advantage
attackTracks.purpose: Build the platform advantage a Gastro-only directory cannot easily copy.
requiredWork: Reuse shared location, trust, identity, intent and action primitives across Gastro, Lifestyle, Works and future verticals.
Measure cross-category sessions and second-vertical launch effort.
Prohibit vertical-specific core forks as a shortcut.

attackTracks.name: Paid merchant proof
attackTracks.purpose: Turn product differentiation into economic evidence rather than a feature story.
requiredWork: Use ACQ-03 settled external payment as the paying-business truth.
Keep one-off Highlight revenue separate from recurring MRR.
Track objections, renewal and 90-day paid retention after authorized launch.

attackTracks.name: Competitive evidence refresh
attackTracks.purpose: Prevent strategy drift as local competitors change.
requiredWork: Re-verify competitor public surfaces before material positioning or investor claims.
Version observations by date and source.
Record unknowns explicitly and prohibit inferred traffic, revenue or market share.

competitiveProofLadder.name: Observed Category Evidence
competitiveProofLadder.rule: Current external local discovery/directory/menu mechanisms are observed; no HOY superiority claim.

competitiveProofLadder.name: Coverage Baseline
competitiveProofLadder.rule: Region-1 coverage/discoverability baseline is measured and versioned.

competitiveProofLadder.name: Freshness and Trust Advantage
competitiveProofLadder.rule: HOY beats its own frozen baseline on critical-field freshness and first-party confirmation without weakened quality gates.

competitiveProofLadder.name: Decision Quality Advantage
competitiveProofLadder.rule: Users demonstrably use structured decision surfaces and progress to qualified high-intent actions.

competitiveProofLadder.name: Repeat Consumer Value
competitiveProofLadder.rule: Activated consumers repeat under a frozen definition; one-off sessions do not qualify.

competitiveProofLadder.name: Merchant Economic Value
competitiveProofLadder.rule: External settled payments plus merchant outcome/renewal evidence exist under ACQ-03/04 rules.

competitiveProofLadder.name: Platform Replication Advantage
competitiveProofLadder.rule: The shared core supports another region and/or vertical without bespoke core rebuilding and with a quality ratchet.
